title: 'America's Got Talent' 2025 Winner Revealed! Here's Who Won - NewsBreak
text:
By Paulette Cohn ,
36 minutes ago
The voting is over, and the results have been revealed for America’s Got Talent 2025 (Season 20) and the winner took home the $1 million prize, the title and a complimentary trip to Universal Orlando.
The 10 finalists included the best performers of the season as voted on by America and AGT judges Simon Cowell , Howie Mandel , Mel B , and Sofia Vergara . They were: Chris Turner, Jessica Sanchez, Jourdan Blue, Leo High School Choir, LightWire, Mama Duke, Micah Palace, Sirca Marea, Steve Ray Ladson and Team Recycled.
And the winner was Jessica Sanchez, who returned to the show after having competed in the first season when she was a child, and returned for Season 20.

Team Recycled Who Won America's Got Talent 2025? Jessica Sanchez Here’s how the night went down:
As usual, the results show opened with host Terry Crews introducing a review of the performance show from Tuesday night as the Top 10 were backstage nervously awaiting the results, but first they had to get through the night’s entertainment, which they were part of.
Performers for the night included Ciara performing her hit “Level Up" with dance crew Team Recycled; Leona Lewis joined by LightWire for a beautiful display of light and sound, Aloe Blacc accompanied by the Leo High School Choir for his song “The Man,” Manuel Turizo joining forces with Micah Palace, Journey founder Neal Schon supporting Season 19’s winner Richard Goodall on his original single “Long Time Coming,” Danny O’Donoghue of The Script reprising Jourdan Blue’s popular audition cover of its single “Breakeven,” and AGT fan-favorite trap choir Sainted combining with Mama Duke for a performance of her original chart topping hit.
Then Terry got down to the real business of the night: the results.
Related: The Real Reason Mastermind Quit America’s Got Talent
Then host Terry Crews got down to the real business of the night: the results.
The countdown for the Top 5 began:
First up to find out if they made the Top 5 were Mama Duke and Chris Turner. There was no doubt that it would be Chris Turner moving on.
Called up next were LightWire and Sirca Marea. Both acts deserved a spot in the Top 5 but only LightWire made it through.
Terry kept it going by calling up Jessica Sanchez and Steve Ray Ladson. The act taking the third spot in the Top 5 was Jessica Sanchez.
Micah Palace and Jourdan Blue were the fourth artists to get their results. After the votes were counted, Jourdan Blue moved into the Top 5.
The final spot was decided between Leo High School Choir and Team Recycled. The act taking the last spot was Leo High School Choir.
Then Terry announced the breakdown for the Top 5:
Fifth place: LightWire
Fourth place: Leo High School Choir
Third place: Jourdan Blue
Second place: Chris Turner
Winner: Jessica Sanchez
